# awx_instance (Resource)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `hostname` (String) Hostname

### Optional

- `capacity_adjustment` (Number) Capacity adjustment
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enabled
- `listener_port` (Number) Listener port
- `managed_by_policy` (Boolean) Managed by policy
- `node_state` (String) Indicates the current life cycle stage of this instance.
- `node_type` (String) Role that this node plays in the mesh.
- `peers` (List of Number) Primary keys of receptor addresses to peer to.
- `peers_from_control_nodes` (Boolean) Peers from control nodes

### Read-Only

- `capacity` (Number) Capacity
- `consumed_capacity` (Number) Consumed capacity
- `cpu` (Number) Cpu
- `cpu_capacity` (Number) Cpu capacity
- `errors` (String) Any error details from the last health check.
- `health_check_pending` (Boolean) Health check pending
- `health_check_started` (String) The last time a health check was initiated on this instance.
- `id` (Number) Database ID for this instance.
- `ip_address` (String) Ip address
- `jobs_running` (Number) Count of jobs in the running or waiting state that are targeted for this instance
- `jobs_total` (Number) Count of all jobs that target this instance
- `last_health_check` (String) Last time a health check was ran on this instance to refresh cpu, memory, and capacity.
- `last_seen` (String) Last time instance ran its heartbeat task for main cluster nodes. Last known connection to receptor mesh for execution nodes.
- `managed` (Boolean) If True, this instance is managed by the control plane.
- `mem_capacity` (Number) Mem capacity
- `memory` (Number) Total system memory of this instance in bytes.
- `percent_capacity_remaining` (Number) Percent capacity remaining
- `protocol` (String) Protocol
- `reverse_peers` (List of Number) Reverse peers
- `uuid` (String) Uuid
- `version` (String) Version
